touches.text: The inspector outputs only its findings. It certifies nothing, records no crossing, and posts nothing; the gate consumes its findings (19.14.1).
build_inspector: python sieves run after a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve." → CodeMother (10.3.5)
artifact: the one door a record of truth changes through, and the journal of who came through it (hash-chained, caller read from the kernel). USERS: everyone who writes a record.
import_sieve: one parse of every .py into an import graph; what reaches what. Enforces "only the proxy reaches the host/database" and RULE 1. → CodeMother

open_questions.text: With 17.11 retired, does the journal still earn its keep? It's what showed a ticket moved by hand (481221f45884). Draft: keep the door and the journal, drop the adjudication.
